alerts.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 1 at 11:32AM EDT until October 1 at 2:30PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Broward County in southeastern Florida...
Northern Miami-Dade County in southeastern Florida...

* WHEN...Until 230 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1132 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have
fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Hialeah, Fort Lauderdale, Pembroke Pines, Hollywood, Miramar,
Coral Springs, Pompano Beach, Davie, Miami Beach, Plantation,
Sunrise, Deerfield Beach, Tamarac, Margate, Lighthouse Point,
Lauderdale-By-The-Sea, Surfside, Hallandale and
